title: Twin runs on main: the current system and Claude as an AI-first agent on one problem, in two lanes at once
request: Phase 3: run the current system and Claude on the same problem at the same time, keep everything both did in its own folder, and compare them step by step; the owner pointed to the twin runs already built on an unmerged branch.
spec: dclab_rnd twin (lanes as workspace folders, the Claude client over the native transport with the run's caps, the comparison, the comparison as twin steps judged against a blind sample's planted truth, the command line), the agent twin in the harness, docs/guides/TWIN_RUNS.md.
plan: Bring the branch's lanes, client, comparison and command line onto main rather than merge a branch that left main long ago.
Replace the branch's decision samples with the ledger and give each lane its own ledger, session record and audit through its workspace services.
Reach Claude through the gateway package's native transport.
Write the comparison as twin steps so many runs make one matrix.

decisions.decision: A run is judged against the sample's solution only when it is blind.
decisions.why: Without blind both lanes are given that solution, and the standard plan copies it: judging against it makes the system right by construction.

decisions.decision: A lane stopped by a cap is stopped, not completed.
decisions.why: A run cut short by its budget must not count as a finished comparison or exit as a success.

decisions.decision: Each step's fingerprint is built from what each lane was given: its table's hash and whether it saw the solution.
decisions.why: Only then can the contract refuse two lanes that answered different inputs.

change: dclab_rnd/twin (new: __init__, __main__, claude, lane, compare), dclab_rnd/agents/harness.py (the agent twin), tests/test_twin_runs.py (new), tests/test_agent_harness.py (its probe; an entry in a package), docs/guides/TWIN_RUNS.md (new), CLAUDE.md, the phase 3 plan.

findings.defect: Seeding the lanes wrote their events into the main workspace's record.
findings.scenario: With the main workspace's log installed, as in a server, the main record received two upload events naming the lanes' projects.
findings.cause: The seeds ran in the main thread outside the lanes' services, so the hooks reached the process's log.
findings.fix: Each seed runs inside its lane's services; the test installs the main log, ledger and gateway and checks the main record holds only the run itself.

findings.defect: The harness test failed for the new agent.
findings.scenario: The agent twin had no probe, its entry is a package, and the run opened no harness session.
findings.cause: The agent was added to the list without its probe or its session.
findings.fix: The run is a session of the agent twin, the probe is named, and the test reads a package's entry from its init.

findings.defect: The planted truth made the system right by construction and faulted a right answer on one sample.
findings.scenario: Without blind the standard plan copies the sample's solution; on the fraud sample the time column is forbidden there but is the time column.
findings.cause: The truth was attached to every sample run and copied the forbidden list whole, identifiers included.
findings.fix: Only a blind run is judged; a time or group column leaves the leak truth; identifiers are not judged.

findings.defect: A lane stopped by a cap was reported as completed.
findings.scenario: A request cap stopped the AI-first lane; the manifest, the list and the steps said completed and the command exited with success.
findings.cause: The budget's ending was mapped to completed and its reason dropped.
findings.fix: The lane is stopped with the reason from the session; its steps reached stay answered.

findings.defect: A run had no euro cap by default and a request could pass the cap.
findings.scenario: A plain run with yes had no euro limit; the cap was checked only once spent, and the workspace's monthly cap was not read.
findings.cause: The default was none and no upper-bound estimate was reserved before a request.
findings.fix: The default is the owner's cap of a run; each request reserves its upper-bound cost; the workspace's monthly cap counts this month's spend; the price is read by the price table's own lookup.

findings.defect: A step's input fingerprint was the same constant for both lanes.
findings.scenario: Two lanes on different tables would still be compared as if they had the same input.
findings.cause: Both arms were stamped with the run's id and the step.
findings.fix: Each lane's fingerprint is its table's hash, whether it saw the solution, and the step; the contract refuses two.

findings.defect: The lanes read the main workspace's routing and lessons.
findings.scenario: A lane's decisions and the routing fingerprint depended on the process's workspace folder.
findings.cause: The lane gateways had no routing and the services no lesson store, so both fell back to the process's.
findings.fix: Each lane has its own routing document and lesson store, and its stores on its services.

findings.defect: The lane client missed parts of the gateway's contract.
findings.scenario: A call naming its purpose raised; the AI-first lane's session record had no model requests; a private scope still got a client.
findings.cause: The client was written against an older gateway.
findings.fix: The refusal takes a purpose, every request writes its model event in the lane's record, and a private scope gets no client.

findings.defect: The twin runs existed only on an unmerged branch.
findings.scenario: The owner pasted their status while phase 3 was being planned.
findings.cause: The branch was never brought to main.
findings.fix: They are on main, adapted to the ledger, the native transport and the session record.

outcome: Twin runs work on main on a scripted transport; no live run yet.
lessons: A thread or a seed that writes events must run inside the services of the folder it belongs to.
Never judge two arms against a truth one of them was handed.
risks: One holdout each: a difference inside the intervals is noise; repeat runs before concluding.
